channel.title: Rwanda - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Rwanda, every source cited.

item.title: RPP youth in Europe meet in Warsaw
item.description: Young RPF members from 19 European countries gathered to discuss Rwanda's development goals.

item.title: Rwanda farmers urged to innovate against climate change
item.description: Minister Ndabamenye calls for new methods to secure food and livestock production from weather threats.

item.title: 1,729 graduates urged to create jobs in Rwanda
item.description: Rwanda aims to create 1.25 million new jobs by 2029, requiring innovation and entrepreneurship from graduates.

item.title: Kagame tells officials to assess performance
item.description: President Paul Kagame urged public officials to regularly assess their performance and improve public service.
